cases.prompt_text: Great, now is there adaptive precision? For example, if I give you an item that has fire resistance and cold resistance on it, adaptive means that it's going to be able to calculate based on equivalent resistance rather than absolute resistance types as an option. Now there is a case where I might need specifically those particular resistances, but much more often equivalent resistances are fine. This is just one example. There are many other examples like this where I don't care how we get to a particular DPS number. There might be more than one combination of physical damage increase and flat damage, etc., that can get to a particular DPS. Maybe I care more about attack speed and I want to focus on attack speed, or maybe I care more about crit and I want to make sure it has an adequate crit level. Are there options built in for prioritizing particular vectors of an item as the priority for a replacement craft?
cases.emitted_task: Does the ranking support adaptive per-attribute weighting, where the same item's attributes like fire resistance and cold resistance are scored differently depending on query context?
